meta.name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
meta.description: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.

videos.title: The Book of Mormons?
videos.overview: After a shaky trip to Palm Springs, one of the girls brings in a new recruit to settle the sides.

videos.title: The Book of Psalm Springs
videos.overview: A dreamy "Palm Royale"-themed trip to Palm Springs turns into a power struggle when McCall hopes the desert oasis will bring the group together under her leadership. Meanwhile, a manicure leads to a leaked secret and marital strain intensifies.

videos.title: The Book of Plastics
videos.overview: As the Palm Springs trip winds down, rifts deepen between the two sides as McCall feels the ground shifting beneath her — she calls upon an old friend to come shake things up. Meanwhile, a stand-up debut doesn't go as planned, leaving some of the women less than entertained, and a mahjong game turns into a battlefield of petty passive aggression.

videos.title: The Book of Loyalty
videos.overview: Just as the group starts to find its footing, cutting comments blow it all up again. When a couple goes Instagram-official — announcing they're back together and expecting — the past resurfaces at the worst possible moment. And as new information comes to light, Jen's fresh start gives way to life-changing questions.

videos.title: The Book of Uncoupling
videos.overview: With tensions boiling over and the group's future in question, a surprise game day is called to force the women to hash it out. Meanwhile, Aspyn extends an olive branch in hopes of finally co-parenting in peace, and one of the women finds the courage to open up to her new friends about a painful chapter from her past.

videos.title: The Book of Déjà Vu
videos.overview: The women plan a redemption trip to Vegas to make up for Jen's disastrous Chippendales blowout from years back — but when one of the husbands' "work trips" lands him in Sin City at the same time, old wounds threaten to reopen. Some of the group call in reinforcements from Utah #MomTok, determined to make this a full-circle moment instead of a repeat disaster. Meanwhile, concerns about where some of women's beliefs stand are reignited.

videos.title: The Book of Control
videos.overview: Back home from Vegas, the simmering feud between Aspyn and McCall finally boils over at a jewelry launch, and an awkward last-minute disinvite from a big birthday raises eyebrows while an uninvited former fling sends shockwaves through the group.

videos.title: The Book of Ashleigh Madison
videos.overview: In the season finale, can the women set aside their differences to rally around one of their own as concerns about her marriage grow? One of the couples reach a breaking point of their own, while others take an unespected turn. Jordan unearths a deep secret from one of the women's past, and Whitney Leavitt returns to Southern California in the hopes of taking care of some unfinished business once and for all.
